_readme: PaMarket video cast. Pick 2-4 characters whose 'fits' match the video topic. Poses are transparent cut-outs made by cutout.py from sheet.png. 'mouth' drives lip-sync in the composition: [x, lipLineY, width] in pose pixels, 'jaw' = feathered lower-face ellipse [cx, cy, rx, ry], 'drop' = max jaw drop in pose pixels. Poses without 'mouth' can appear but not speak. Voices must be usable on the FREE ElevenLabs tier. Many professional library voices fail with 'You need to be on the creator tier', so reuse the ids below. ACCENTS: Southern African, British or American only, never West African.

rudo.name: Rudo
rudo.role: Artisan tailor with a stall in Mbare
rudo.personality: Warm, proud of her craft, quick to laugh

pose-3.webp.view: excited, holding up a cushion (cushion also works as a listing photo: crop x700 y20 w540 h560)

tariro.name: Tariro
tariro.personality: Excitable, deal-hunter, always on her phone

voice.note: Previous voice was Nigerian-accented; the founder rejected it. Use a Southern African, British or American voice only.

pose-2.webp.view: 3/4 facing screen-right (don't mirror: hoodie text flips)

pose-3.webp.view: dynamic pose + back view merged. AVOID: phone screen and shopping bags carry garbled AI text

sekuru-tadiwa.name: Sekuru Tadiwa
sekuru-tadiwa.role: Wise market elder and retail advisor
sekuru-tadiwa.personality: Kind, tech-savvy, wise; calls people 'my child'

pose-1.webp.view: front, tablet at hip. Tablet top text is garbled: cover it with the 'patch' used in sample/index.html (CAST.sek1)

nyasha.name: Nyasha
nyasha.role: Friendly helper with a headset (customer support)

voice.note: Previous voice was Nigerian-accented; the founder rejected it. Use a Southern African, British or American voice only.

pose-3.webp.view: thumbs up + phone with green check

farai.name: Farai
fits: sellers' own delivery details on a listing
farai.caution: PaMarket has no courier service of its own. Only show Farai delivering for a seller, never as a PaMarket courier. The jacket logo reads 'ZNLDOETGS' (garbled), so keep him small or regenerate the sheet.

character-3.role: Young woman, print bomber jacket, holds a phone (name not given yet; ask the founder)
character-3.caution: Sheet includes grey sketch expression heads (pose-5..7) and the phone screen text is garbled.
